notes.title: Update Marblous to version 1.01
notes.notes:
Fix issue with time measurement
Fix decal visual bug.
Adding 2 new Decals:
Necrocatic
Cootado

notes.title: Version 1.0.3, fix major bug.
notes.notes:
Hello,

There was a bug for a while where it wouldn't jump sometimes even if you press space or jump.
The bug happened when you held the right key down(not leaving it), the first time it jumps, but if you keep holding the key, the second time wouldn't jump.

This is now fixed in version 1.0.3.

Please let me know if there are any other issues.

notes.title: Demo Version 1.0.21, fixed UI bug in levels
notes.notes:
With version 1.0.21 of the Demo I have fixed the bug that the default button to be selected after losing, is the quit.
This will cause players to accidently quit the game.
Now the default button is the conintue.

In addition I added another Decal.

The best record for the first level is now [b]32.75[/b] seconds.
My record is [b]34.72[/b] seconds.

The leaderboards is not visible right now, because a Demo leaderboard cannot be visible on Steam.
The full game will have a leaderboard in the Steam page though.

Thanks,
Ofer.
